en.title: Taylor Sheridan's 'Lioness' Returns: What to Expect from Season 3 on Paramount+
en.summary: US dramas are now more accessible than ever in the UK, bridging the gap for international fans. Taylor Sheridan's intense spy thriller 'Lioness' is set to premiere its third season, bringing back Zoe Saldaña and Nicole Kidman.
en.body:
The frustration of discovering a must-watch US drama only to find it unavailable in your region is a familiar one for global television enthusiasts. Fortunately, the landscape is rapidly changing. Thanks to strategic deals between US streaming giants and UK broadcasters like Sky and ITV, award-winning American series are reaching international audiences faster than ever before. While simultaneous release dates remain a rarity, the wait is significantly shorter, allowing fans worldwide to stay current with critical hits.

This week, attention turns to **Taylor Sheridan**'s gripping espionage thriller, **Lioness**. Starring **Zoe Saldaña** as Joe and **Nicole Kidman** as Kaitlyn, the Paramount+ series is known for its high-stakes narrative and intense character development. The show, which swaps Sheridan's signature Western landscapes for the shadowy world of intelligence agencies, explores the perilous lives of operatives tasked with infiltrating dangerous organizations. Season 3 promises to escalate the personal and professional conflicts that define the series, with Joe finding herself increasingly entangled in a web of deceit and danger that threatens to consume her life outside of the mission.

## Inside the Lioness's Next Mission

The official synopsis for **Lioness** season 3 hints at a complex and personal assignment for Joe. As "unseen forces" begin to circle her world, familiar patterns dissolve, and identities shift. Guided by the experienced Kaitlyn and the enigmatic Westfield, played by **Michael Kelly**, Joe must confront adversaries operating from the shadows. This season appears poised to explore the profound personal cost of espionage, as the war Joe fights on the front lines inevitably bleeds into every aspect of her home life. Fans who need a refresher on the intricate plotlines and character dynamics from the previous season will find solace in detailed episode recaps, ensuring they are fully prepared for the premiere.

## What This Means for Binge-Watchers

For the dedicated fanbase of **Taylor Sheridan**'s work, the return of **Lioness** is a significant event. Sheridan has cultivated a devoted following with shows like **Yellowstone** and **1883**, known for their meticulous world-building and morally complex characters. **Lioness** offers a different, yet equally compelling, brand of storytelling, focusing on the psychological toll of covert operations and the blurred lines between duty and personal loyalty. The accessibility of the series on UK platforms means that this dedicated audience can continue to engage with Sheridan's latest narrative without significant delay, fostering a shared global viewing experience.

## What's Next

**Lioness** season 3 is set to premiere on August 2nd, offering fans a fresh installment of espionage and personal drama. Viewers can expect the series to continue its exploration of the psychological challenges faced by intelligence operatives, with Joe's journey at the forefront.

es.title: La temporada 3 de 'Lioness' de Taylor Sheridan ya está aquí: ¿Qué esperar en Paramount+?
es.summary: Las series de drama estadounidenses están más al alcance de los fanáticos internacionales que nunca, y la emocionante serie de espionaje 'Lioness' de Taylor Sheridan está a punto de estrenar su tercera temporada con Zoe Saldaña y Nicole Kidman. La plataforma de streaming Paramount+ ofrece una oportunidad única para que los espectadores disfruten de esta serie de alto riesgo y desarrollo de personajes intensos.
es.body:
La frustración de descubrir una serie de drama estadounidense imprescindible solo para encontrarla no disponible en tu región es algo con lo que muchos entusiastas de la televisión global están familiarizados. Afortunadamente, el panorama está cambiando rápidamente. Gracias a acuerdos estratégicos entre gigantes del streaming estadounidense y emisoras del Reino Unido como Sky e ITV, las series estadounidenses galardonadas están alcanzando a las audiencias internacionales más rápido que nunca. Si bien las fechas de estreno simultáneo siguen siendo una rareza, la espera es significativamente más corta, lo que permite a los fanáticos de todo el mundo mantenerse al día con los éxitos críticos.

 
## Dentro de la próxima misión de Lioness

Esta semana, la atención se centra en la emocionante serie de espionaje de **Taylor Sheridan**, **Lioness**. Protagonizada por **Zoe Saldaña** como Joe y **Nicole Kidman** como Kaitlyn, la serie de Paramount+ es conocida por su narrativa de alto riesgo y su desarrollo de personajes intenso. La serie, que cambia los paisajes occidentales característicos de Sheridan por el mundo sombrío de las agencias de inteligencia, explora las vidas peligrosas de los operativos encargados de infiltrarse en organizaciones peligrosas. La temporada 3 promete intensificar los conflictos personales y profesionales que definen la serie, con Joe encontrándose cada vez más atrapada en una red de engaño y peligro que amenaza con consumir su vida fuera de la misión.

 
## ¿Qué significa esto para los fanáticos de las maratones?

Para la base de fanáticos dedicados de la obra de **Taylor Sheridan**, el regreso de **Lioness** es un evento significativo. Sheridan ha cultivado un seguimiento devoto con series como **Yellowstone** y **1883**, conocidas por su meticulosa construcción de mundos y personajes moralmente complejos. **Lioness** ofrece una marca diferente, pero igualmente atractiva, de narrativa, centrada en el costo psicológico de las operaciones encubiertas y las líneas borrosas entre el deber y la lealtad personal. La accesibilidad de la serie en plataformas del Reino Unido significa que esta audiencia dedicada puede continuar interactuando con la última narrativa de Sheridan sin retrasos significativos, fomentando una experiencia de visualización global compartida.

 
## Próximos Pasos

La temporada 3 de **Lioness** está programada para estrenarse el 2 de agosto, ofreciendo a los fanáticos una nueva entrega de espionaje y drama personal. Los espectadores pueden esperar que la serie continúe explorando los desafíos psicológicos que enfrentan los operativos de inteligencia, con el viaje de Joe en el centro de la trama.

content_raw: We've all faced the disappointment of finding a US drama we really want to watch, only for it not to be available in the UK. The US is constantly creating must-see entertainment content and you might be thinking that these programs are only available to US audiences — but that's not the case. Thanks to these US streaming platforms securing deals with UK broadcasters like Sky and ITV, we can now watch award-winning content from a variety of genres. Although the UK isn't guaranteed the same release date as those across the pond, it saves you from waiting an age until they reach UK screens. Here are the US dramas available to watch on both UK channels and streaming this week, as well as our top picks. Lioness season 3 (Image credit: Ryan Green/Paramount+) Zoe Saldaña and Nicole Kidman are back on the front lines in Taylor Sheridan 's epic Paramount+ spy thriller, Lioness. The Yellowstone creator has swapped his signature dusty neo-Western dramas for a female-led espionage nail-biter which sees chaos ensue when "hidden networks, foreign operatives, and personal betrayals collide" as the Lioness team embark on a personal assignment. The official synopsis of Lioness season 3 reads: "Joe (Saldaña) walks the line between duty and home as unseen forces circle her world. Patterns appear where they shouldn’t, names vanish, and paths rearrange. Guided by Kaitlyn (Kidman) and Westfield (Michael Kelly), Joe confronts enemies operating in the shadows, leaving her to reckon with a war that now reaches into every part of her life." If you need a refresher on what happened in the previous season before the third instalment premieres on 2 August, check out the episode recaps in our Lioness season 2 guide. Ted Lasso season 4 (Image credit: Apple TV) The global smash hit comedy Ted Lasso is back to score another goal on Apple TV . In Ted Lasso season 4 , Jason Sudeikis' moustachioed coach returns to Richmond to coach a second division women's football team where they will learn to leap before they look and take chances they never thought they would. Fan favourites Hannah Waddingham, Juno Temple, Brett Goldstein, Brendan Hunt, and Jeremy Swift all return this season, alongside newcomers Tanya Reynolds, Jude Mack, Faye Marsay, Rex Hayes, Aisling Sharkey, Abbie Hern, and Grant Feely. My Life with the Walter Boys season 3 (Image credit: Courtesy of Netflix © 2026) Giddy up for more drama as the third season of My Life with the Walter Boys gallops onto Netflix on 6 August. The romantic drama picks up after the season 2 finale where Alex (Ashby Gentry) overheard his girlfriend Jackie (Nikki Rodriguez) and brother Cole (Noah LaLonde) confess their love for each other. However, they were interrupted when their father George (Marc Blucas) was rushed to hospital. So what's next for the trio this time around?
